202.title: Defendant's Interrogatories
202.deadline_text: Answers are due under oath within sixty (60) days of filing.

items.label: a
items.prompt: State the following:
items.text: your full name and any other name(s) by which you have been known;

items.label: b
items.prompt: State the following:
items.text: your date of birth;

items.label: c
items.prompt: State the following:
items.text: your motor vehicle operator’s license number;

items.label: d
items.prompt: State the following:
items.text: your home address;

items.label: e
items.prompt: State the following:
items.text: your business address;

items.label: f
items.prompt: State the following:
items.text: if you were not the owner of the subject vehicle, the name and address of the owner or lessor of the subject vehicle on the date of the alleged occurrence.
Identify and list each injury you claim to have sustained as a result of the incidents alleged in the Complaint.
When, where and from whom did you first receive treatment for said injuries?
If you were treated at a hospital for injuries sustained in the alleged incident, state the name and location of each hospital and the dates of such treatment and confinement therein.
State the name and address of each physician, therapist or other source of treatment for the conditions or injuries you sustained as a result of the incident alleged in your Complaint.
When and from whom did you last receive any medical attention for injuries alleged to have been sustained as a result of the incident alleged in your Complaint?
On what date were you fully recovered from the injuries or conditions alleged in your Complaint?
If you claim you are not fully recovered, state precisely from what injuries or conditions you are presently suffering.
Are you presently under the care of any doctor or other health care provider for the treatment of injuries alleged to have been sustained as a result of the incident alleged in your Complaint?
If the answer to Interrogatory #9 is in the affirmative, state the name and address of each physician or other health care provider who is treating you.
Do you claim any present disability resulting from injuries or conditions allegedly sustained as a result of the incident alleged in your Complaint?
If so, state the nature of the disability claimed.
Do you claim any permanent disability resulting from said incident?

items.label: a
items.prompt: If the answer to Interrogatory #13 is in the affirmative, please answer the following:
items.text: list the parts of your body which are disabled;

items.label: b
items.prompt: If the answer to Interrogatory #13 is in the affirmative, please answer the following:
items.text: list the motions, activities or use of your body which you have lost or which you are unable to perform;

items.label: c
items.prompt: If the answer to Interrogatory #13 is in the affirmative, please answer the following:
items.text: state the percentage of loss of use claimed as to each part of your body;

items.label: d
items.prompt: If the answer to Interrogatory #13 is in the affirmative, please answer the following:
items.text: state the name and address of the person who made the prognosis for permanent disability and the percentage of loss of use;

items.label: e
items.prompt: If the answer to Interrogatory #13 is in the affirmative, please answer the following:
items.text: list the date for each such prognosis.
If you were or are confined to your home or your bed as a result of injuries or conditions sustained as a result of the incident alleged in your Complaint, state the dates you were so confined.

List each medical report received by you or your attorney relating to your alleged injuries or conditions by stating the name and address of the treating doctor or other health care provider, and of any doctor or health care person you anticipate calling as a trial witness, who provided each such report and the date thereof.

List each item of expense which you claim to have incurred as a result of the incident alleged in your Complaint, the amount thereof, and state the name and address of the person or organization to whom each item has been paid or is payable.

For each item of expense identified in response to Interrogatory #17, if any such expense, or portion thereof, has been paid or reimbursed or is reimbursable by an insurer, state, as to each such item of expense, the name of the insurer that made such payment or reimbursement or that is responsible for such reimbursement.

If, during the ten year period prior to the date of the incident alleged in the Complaint, you were under a doctor’s care for any conditions which were in any way similar or related to those identified and listed in your response to Interrogatory #2, state the nature of said conditions, the dates on which treatment was received, and the name of the doctor or health care provider.

items.label: a
items.prompt: If, during the ten year period prior to the date of the incident alleged in your Complaint, you were involved in any incident in which you received personal injuries similar or related to those identified and listed in your response to Interrogatory #2, please answer the following with respect to each such earlier incident:
items.text: on what date and in what manner did you sustain such injuries?

items.label: b
items.prompt: If, during the ten year period prior to the date of the incident alleged in your Complaint, you were involved in any incident in which you received personal injuries similar or related to those identified and listed in your response to Interrogatory #2, please answer the following with respect to each such earlier incident:
items.text: did you make a claim against anyone as a result of said accident?

items.label: c
items.prompt: If, during the ten year period prior to the date of the incident alleged in your Complaint, you were involved in any incident in which you received personal injuries similar or related to those identified and listed in your response to Interrogatory #2, please answer the following with respect to each such earlier incident:
items.text: if so, provide the name(s) and address(es) of the person or persons against whom a claim was made;

items.label: d
items.prompt: If, during the ten year period prior to the date of the incident alleged in your Complaint, you were involved in any incident in which you received personal injuries similar or related to those identified and listed in your response to Interrogatory #2, please answer the following with respect to each such earlier incident:
items.text: if suit was brought, state the name and location of the Court, the return date of the suit, and the docket number;

items.label: e
items.prompt: If, during the ten year period prior to the date of the incident alleged in your Complaint, you were involved in any incident in which you received personal injuries similar or related to those identified and listed in your response to Interrogatory #2, please answer the following with respect to each such earlier incident:
items.text: state the nature of the injuries received in said accident;

items.label: f
items.prompt: If, during the ten year period prior to the date of the incident alleged in your Complaint, you were involved in any incident in which you received personal injuries similar or related to those identified and listed in your response to Interrogatory #2, please answer the following with respect to each such earlier incident:
items.text: state the name and address of each physician who treated you for said injuries;

items.label: g
items.prompt: If, during the ten year period prior to the date of the incident alleged in your Complaint, you were involved in any incident in which you received personal injuries similar or related to those identified and listed in your response to Interrogatory #2, please answer the following with respect to each such earlier incident:
items.text: state the dates on which you were so treated;

items.label: h
items.prompt: If, during the ten year period prior to the date of the incident alleged in your Complaint, you were involved in any incident in which you received personal injuries similar or related to those identified and listed in your response to Interrogatory #2, please answer the following with respect to each such earlier incident:
items.text: state the nature of the treatment received on each such date;

items.label: i
items.prompt: If, during the ten year period prior to the date of the incident alleged in your Complaint, you were involved in any incident in which you received personal injuries similar or related to those identified and listed in your response to Interrogatory #2, please answer the following with respect to each such earlier incident:
items.text: if you are presently or permanently disabled as a result of said injuries, please state the nature of such disability, the name and address of each physician who diagnosed said disability and the date of each such diagnosis.

items.label: a
items.prompt: If you were involved in any incident in which you received personal injuries since the date of the incident alleged in the Complaint, please answer the following:
items.text: on what date and in what manner did you sustain said injuries?

items.label: b
items.prompt: If you were involved in any incident in which you received personal injuries since the date of the incident alleged in the Complaint, please answer the following:
items.text: did you make a claim against anyone as a result of said accident?

items.label: c
items.prompt: If you were involved in any incident in which you received personal injuries since the date of the incident alleged in the Complaint, please answer the following:
items.text: if so, provide the name(s) and address(es) of the person or persons against whom a claim was made;

items.label: d
items.prompt: If you were involved in any incident in which you received personal injuries since the date of the incident alleged in the Complaint, please answer the following:
items.text: if suit was brought, state the name and location of the Court, the return date of the suit, and the docket number;

items.label: e
items.prompt: If you were involved in any incident in which you received personal injuries since the date of the incident alleged in the Complaint, please answer the following:
items.text: state the nature of the injuries received in said accident;

items.label: f
items.prompt: If you were involved in any incident in which you received personal injuries since the date of the incident alleged in the Complaint, please answer the following:
items.text: state the name and address of each physician who treated you for said injuries;

items.label: g
items.prompt: If you were involved in any incident in which you received personal injuries since the date of the incident alleged in the Complaint, please answer the following:
items.text: state the dates on which you were so treated;

items.label: h
items.prompt: If you were involved in any incident in which you received personal injuries since the date of the incident alleged in the Complaint, please answer the following:
items.text: state the nature of the treatment received on each such date;

items.label: i
items.prompt: If you were involved in any incident in which you received personal injuries since the date of the incident alleged in the Complaint, please answer the following:
items.text: if you are presently or permanently disabled as a result of said injuries, please state the nature of such disability, the name and address of each physician who diagnosed said disability and the date of each such diagnosis.

items.label: a
items.prompt: Please state the name and address of any medical service provider who has rendered an opinion in writing or through testimony that you have sustained a permanent disability to any body part other than those listed in response to Interrogatories #13, #14, #20 or #21, and:
items.text: list each such part of your body that has been assessed a permanent disability;

items.label: b
items.prompt: Please state the name and address of any medical service provider who has rendered an opinion in writing or through testimony that you have sustained a permanent disability to any body part other than those listed in response to Interrogatories #13, #14, #20 or #21, and:
items.text: state the percentage of loss of use assessed as to each part of your body;

items.label: c
items.prompt: Please state the name and address of any medical service provider who has rendered an opinion in writing or through testimony that you have sustained a permanent disability to any body part other than those listed in response to Interrogatories #13, #14, #20 or #21, and:
items.text: state the date on which each such assessment was made.

items.label: a
items.prompt: If you claim that as a result of the incident alleged in your Complaint you were prevented from following your usual occupation, or otherwise lost time from work, please provide the following information:
items.text: the name and address of your employer on the date of the incident alleged in the Complaint;

items.label: b
items.prompt: If you claim that as a result of the incident alleged in your Complaint you were prevented from following your usual occupation, or otherwise lost time from work, please provide the following information:
items.text: the nature of your occupation and a precise description of your job responsibilities with said employer on the date of the incident alleged in the Complaint;

items.label: c
items.prompt: If you claim that as a result of the incident alleged in your Complaint you were prevented from following your usual occupation, or otherwise lost time from work, please provide the following information:
items.text: your average, weekly earnings, salary, or income received from said employment for the year preceding the date of the incident alleged in the Complaint;

items.label: d
items.prompt: If you claim that as a result of the incident alleged in your Complaint you were prevented from following your usual occupation, or otherwise lost time from work, please provide the following information:
items.text: the date following the date of the incident alleged in the Complaint on which you resumed the duties of said employment;

items.label: e
items.prompt: If you claim that as a result of the incident alleged in your Complaint you were prevented from following your usual occupation, or otherwise lost time from work, please provide the following information:
items.text: what loss of income do you claim as a result of the incident alleged in your Complaint and how is said loss computed?

items.label: f
items.prompt: If you claim that as a result of the incident alleged in your Complaint you were prevented from following your usual occupation, or otherwise lost time from work, please provide the following information:
items.text: the dates on which you were unable to perform the duties of your occupation and lost time from work as a result of injuries or conditions claimed to have been sustained as a result of the incident alleged in your Complaint;

items.label: g
items.prompt: If you claim that as a result of the incident alleged in your Complaint you were prevented from following your usual occupation, or otherwise lost time from work, please provide the following information:
items.text: the name(s) and address(es) of each employer for whom you worked for three years prior to the date of the incident alleged in your Complaint.
Do you claim an impairment of earning capacity?
List any other expenses or loss and the amount thereof not already set forth and which you claim to have incurred as a result of the incident alleged in your Complaint.

If you have signed a covenant not to sue, a release or discharge of any claim you had, have or may have against any person, corporation or other entity as a result of the incident alleged in your Complaint, please state in whose favor it was given, the date thereof, and the consideration paid to you for giving it.

If you or anyone on your behalf agreed or made an agreement with any person, corporation or other entity to limit in any way the liability of such person, corporation or other entity as a result of any claim you have or may have as a result of the incident alleged in your Complaint, please state in whose favor it was given, the date thereof, and the consideration paid to you for giving it.
If since the date of the incident alleged in your Complaint, you have made any claims for workers’ compensation benefits, state the nature of such claims and the dates on which they were made.
Have you made any statements, as defined in Practice Book Section 13-1, to any person regarding any of the events or happenings alleged in your Complaint?
State the names and addresses of all persons known to you who were present at the time of the incident alleged in your Complaint or who observed or witnessed all or part of the accident.

items.label: a
items.prompt: As to each individual named in response to Interrogatory #30, state whether to your knowledge, or the knowledge of your attorney, such individual has given any statement or statements as defined in Practice Book Section 13-1 concerning the subject matter of your Complaint or alleged injuries. If your answer to this interrogatory is affirmative, state also:
items.text: the date on which such statement or statements were taken;

items.label: b
items.prompt: As to each individual named in response to Interrogatory #30, state whether to your knowledge, or the knowledge of your attorney, such individual has given any statement or statements as defined in Practice Book Section 13-1 concerning the subject matter of your Complaint or alleged injuries. If your answer to this interrogatory is affirmative, state also:
items.text: the name(s) and address(es) of the person or persons who took such statement or statements;

items.label: c
items.prompt: As to each individual named in response to Interrogatory #30, state whether to your knowledge, or the knowledge of your attorney, such individual has given any statement or statements as defined in Practice Book Section 13-1 concerning the subject matter of your Complaint or alleged injuries. If your answer to this interrogatory is affirmative, state also:
items.text: the name(s) and address(es) of any person or persons present when such statement or statements were taken;

items.label: d
items.prompt: As to each individual named in response to Interrogatory #30, state whether to your knowledge, or the knowledge of your attorney, such individual has given any statement or statements as defined in Practice Book Section 13-1 concerning the subject matter of your Complaint or alleged injuries. If your answer to this interrogatory is affirmative, state also:
items.text: whether such statement or statements were written, made by recording device or taken by a court reporter or stenographer;

items.label: e
items.prompt: As to each individual named in response to Interrogatory #30, state whether to your knowledge, or the knowledge of your attorney, such individual has given any statement or statements as defined in Practice Book Section 13-1 concerning the subject matter of your Complaint or alleged injuries. If your answer to this interrogatory is affirmative, state also:
items.text: the name(s) and address(es) of any person or persons having custody or a copy or copies of such statement or statements.

items.label: a
items.prompt: Are you aware of any photographs or any recordings by film, video, audio or any other digital or electronic means depicting the incident alleged in the Complaint, the scene of the incident, any vehicle involved in the incident alleged in the Complaint, or any condition or injury alleged to have been caused by the incident alleged in the Complaint? If so, for each set of photographs or each recording taken, obtained or prepared of each such subject, please state:
items.text: the name and address of the person who took, obtained or prepared such photograph or recording, other than an expert who will not testify at trial;

items.label: b
items.prompt: Are you aware of any photographs or any recordings by film, video, audio or any other digital or electronic means depicting the incident alleged in the Complaint, the scene of the incident, any vehicle involved in the incident alleged in the Complaint, or any condition or injury alleged to have been caused by the incident alleged in the Complaint? If so, for each set of photographs or each recording taken, obtained or prepared of each such subject, please state:
items.text: the dates on which such photographs were taken or such recordings were obtained or prepared;

items.label: c
items.prompt: Are you aware of any photographs or any recordings by film, video, audio or any other digital or electronic means depicting the incident alleged in the Complaint, the scene of the incident, any vehicle involved in the incident alleged in the Complaint, or any condition or injury alleged to have been caused by the incident alleged in the Complaint? If so, for each set of photographs or each recording taken, obtained or prepared of each such subject, please state:
items.text: the subject (e.g., ‘‘Plaintiff’s vehicle,’’ ‘‘scene,’’ etc.);

items.label: d
items.prompt: Are you aware of any photographs or any recordings by film, video, audio or any other digital or electronic means depicting the incident alleged in the Complaint, the scene of the incident, any vehicle involved in the incident alleged in the Complaint, or any condition or injury alleged to have been caused by the incident alleged in the Complaint? If so, for each set of photographs or each recording taken, obtained or prepared of each such subject, please state:
items.text: the number of photographs or recordings;

items.label: e
items.prompt: Are you aware of any photographs or any recordings by film, video, audio or any other digital or electronic means depicting the incident alleged in the Complaint, the scene of the incident, any vehicle involved in the incident alleged in the Complaint, or any condition or injury alleged to have been caused by the incident alleged in the Complaint? If so, for each set of photographs or each recording taken, obtained or prepared of each such subject, please state:
items.text: the nature of the recording (e.g., film, video, audio, etc.).

If you were the operator of any motor vehicle involved in the incident that is the subject of this action, please state whether you consumed or used any alcoholic beverages, drugs or medications within the eight (8) hours next preceding the time of the incident alleged in the Complaint and, if so, indicate what you consumed or used, how much you consumed, and when.

items.label: a
items.prompt: Please state whether, within eight (8) hours after the incident alleged in the Complaint, any testing was performed to determine the presence of alcohol, drugs or other medications in your blood, and, if so, state:
items.text: the name and address of the hospital, person or entity performing such test or screen;

items.label: b
items.prompt: Please state whether, within eight (8) hours after the incident alleged in the Complaint, any testing was performed to determine the presence of alcohol, drugs or other medications in your blood, and, if so, state:
items.text: the date and time;

items.label: c
items.prompt: Please state whether, within eight (8) hours after the incident alleged in the Complaint, any testing was performed to determine the presence of alcohol, drugs or other medications in your blood, and, if so, state:
items.text: the results.

Please identify surveillance material discoverable under Practice Book Section 13-3 (c), by stating the name and address of any person who obtained or prepared any and all recordings, by film, photograph, video, audio or any other digital or electronic means, of any party concerning this lawsuit or its subject matter, including any transcript thereof which are in your possession or control or in the possession or control of your attorney, and state the date on which each such recordings were obtained and the person or persons of whom each such recording was made.
Did you make a claim for workers’ compensation benefits as a result of the incident/occurrence alleged in the Complaint?
Did you receive workers’ compensation benefits as a result of the incident/occurrence alleged in the Complaint?

If you were the operator of any motor vehicle involved in the incident that is the subject of this action, please state whether you were using a cell phone for any activity including, but not limited to, calling, texting, emailing, posting, tweeting, or visiting sites on the Internet for any purpose, at or immediately prior to the time of the incident.

207.title: Interrogatories - Actions To Establish, Enforce or Modify Child Support Orders
207.court: Superior Court - Family Support Magistrate Division
207.deadline_text: Answers are due within sixty (60) days of filing.

items.label: a
items.prompt: For your present residence:
items.text: What is the address?

items.label: b
items.prompt: For your present residence:
items.text: What type of property is it (apartment, condominium, single-family home)?

items.label: c
items.prompt: For your present residence:
items.text: Who is the owner of the property?

items.label: d
items.prompt: For your present residence:
items.text: What is your relationship to the owner (landlord, parents, spouse)?

items.label: e
items.prompt: For your present residence:
items.text: When did you start living at this residence?

items.label: a
items.prompt: List the names of all the adults that live with you.
items.text: For each adult you live with, what is your relationship to them (spouse, sibling, roommate, parent, girlfriend or boyfriend)?

items.label: b
items.prompt: List the names of all the adults that live with you.
items.text: For each adult you live with, what is their financial contribution to the household (who pays the rent, who pays the utilities, who buys the groceries)?

items.label: a
items.prompt: Give the name and address of your employer.
items.text: Are you employed full-time or part-time? Are you self-employed? If you are self-employed, do not answer (b) through (h) and go directly to Interrogatory #4.

items.label: b
items.prompt: Give the name and address of your employer.
items.text: Are you paid a salary, on an hourly basis, or do you work on commission or tips?

items.label: c
items.prompt: Give the name and address of your employer.
items.text: What is your income per week?

items.label: d
items.prompt: Give the name and address of your employer.
items.text: How many hours per week do you usually work?

items.label: e
items.prompt: Give the name and address of your employer.
items.text: Is overtime available, and if it is, how many hours per week do you work overtime and what are you paid?

items.label: f
items.prompt: Give the name and address of your employer.
items.text: Do you receive, or have you ever received, bonus income from your employment and what is the basis for the bonus?

items.label: g
items.prompt: Give the name and address of your employer.
items.text: Does your employer deduct federal and state taxes and Medicare from your wages or are you responsible for filing your own deductions? If you file, provide a copy of your most recent tax returns.

items.label: h
items.prompt: Give the name and address of your employer.
items.text: Do you have a second source of employment? If so, please provide the same information as requested in (a) through (g).

items.label: a
items.prompt: If you are self-employed:
items.text: Are you part of a partnership, corporation or LLC, and if you are, give the name of the business and your role in it?

items.label: b
items.prompt: If you are self-employed:
items.text: Name the other people involved in your business and their roles.

items.label: c
items.prompt: If you are self-employed:
items.text: Does the business file taxes (if so, bring copies of the last two tax returns filed to your next court date)?

items.label: d
items.prompt: If you are self-employed:
items.text: Describe the work you do.

items.label: e
items.prompt: If you are self-employed:
items.text: How many hours per week do you work, on average?

items.label: f
items.prompt: If you are self-employed:
items.text: How much do you typically earn per hour?

items.label: g
items.prompt: If you are self-employed:
items.text: List your business expenses, and what they cost per week.

items.label: h
items.prompt: If you are self-employed:
items.text: State how you are typically paid (check or cash).

items.label: i
items.prompt: If you are self-employed:
items.text: Name the five people or companies you did most of your work for in the last year.

items.label: j
items.prompt: If you are self-employed:
items.text: If you have a business account, what bank is it at (bring copies of the last six months of bank statements to your next court date)?

items.label: k
items.prompt: If you are self-employed:
items.text: Do you work alone or do you employ anyone and pay them wages? If you employ anyone, please identify them, their relationship to you, if any, and the amount you pay them.

items.label: l
items.prompt: If you are self-employed:
items.text: How do you keep your payment and expense records? Do you employ an accountant, and if so, please give the name and address of the accountant responsible for your records?

Except for your current job, list all the places you have worked for in the last three years. For each place, list the address, the type of work you did, the dates you worked there and how much you were paid at each job.

items.label: a
items.prompt: If you cannot work because of a disability, what is the nature of your disability?
items.text: What is the date you became disabled?

items.label: b
items.prompt: If you cannot work because of a disability, what is the nature of your disability?
items.text: Is this disability permanent or temporary?

items.label: c
items.prompt: If you cannot work because of a disability, what is the nature of your disability?
items.text: If a doctor has told you that you cannot work, what is the name of the doctor and his or her office (bring a note from this doctor stating that you cannot work to your next court date)?

items.label: d
items.prompt: If you cannot work because of a disability, what is the nature of your disability?
items.text: If a doctor has told you that you cannot work, did he or she say you cannot work full-time or part-time?

items.label: e
items.prompt: If you cannot work because of a disability, what is the nature of your disability?
items.text: If you have a partial or permanent disability, please provide the percentage rating.

items.label: f
items.prompt: If you cannot work because of a disability, what is the nature of your disability?
items.text: Is your disability the result of an automobile accident, an accident at work, an accident at home or otherwise? Please give the date and details of the incident and state whether you have filed a lawsuit or workers’ compensation claim as a result.

items.label: g
items.prompt: If you cannot work because of a disability, what is the nature of your disability?
items.text: Have you had any children since the incident? If so, list their dates of birth.

items.label: a
items.prompt: Have you applied for Social Security Disability (SSD) or Supplemental Security Income (SSI)?
items.text: If you did, when did you apply and where are you in the application process?

items.label: b
items.prompt: Have you applied for Social Security Disability (SSD) or Supplemental Security Income (SSI)?
items.text: Have you been told if or when you will receive benefits? If so, who told you and what is the date they gave you?

items.label: c
items.prompt: Have you applied for Social Security Disability (SSD) or Supplemental Security Income (SSI)?
items.text: If your application for SSD and/or SSI has been denied, did you appeal? If you appealed, what is the status of the appeal and what lawyer, if any, represents you?

items.label: d
items.prompt: Have you applied for Social Security Disability (SSD) or Supplemental Security Income (SSI)?
items.text: Have you applied for or are you receiving state assistance?

items.label: e
items.prompt: Have you applied for Social Security Disability (SSD) or Supplemental Security Income (SSI)?
items.text: Are you a recipient of the state supplement program, medical assistance program, temporary family assistance program or state-administered general assistance program (SAGA medical or cash)? If so, state the source of the benefit, the effective date of the benefit and the date when your eligibility for benefits will be redetermined by the Department of Social Services.

items.label: a
items.prompt: Do you have any lawsuits pending?
items.text: If you do, what type of case is it?

items.label: b
items.prompt: Do you have any lawsuits pending?
items.text: Give the name, address, email address and phone number of the lawyer handling the case for you.

items.label: c
items.prompt: Do you have any lawsuits pending?
items.text: What amount do you expect to recover and when do you expect to receive it?

items.label: d
items.prompt: Do you have any lawsuits pending?
items.text: If you have already settled the case, please provide a copy of the settlement statement.

items.label: a
items.prompt: Do you expect to inherit any money or property in the next six months?
items.text: If you do, who do you expect to inherit from and where do they or where did they live?

items.label: b
items.prompt: Do you expect to inherit any money or property in the next six months?
items.text: What do you expect to inherit, what is its value and when do you expect to inherit it?

items.label: c
items.prompt: Do you expect to inherit any money or property in the next six months?
items.text: What is the name and address of the person or lawyer handling the estate and where is the Probate Court in which the action is filed?
Is anyone holding any money for you? If so, name the person, their relationship to you, their address and the amount of money they are holding.

items.label: a
items.prompt: Do you own any rental properties, by yourself, with someone else or in trust? If the answer is yes:
items.text: Is the property residential or commercial?

items.label: b
items.prompt: Do you own any rental properties, by yourself, with someone else or in trust? If the answer is yes:
items.text: Please identify the location of the property or properties, include the address and identify your ownership interest.

items.label: c
items.prompt: Do you own any rental properties, by yourself, with someone else or in trust? If the answer is yes:
items.text: Do you derive any income from the property? Do you calculate your net income from the property on a weekly, monthly or yearly basis?

items.label: d
items.prompt: Do you own any rental properties, by yourself, with someone else or in trust? If the answer is yes:
items.text: What are your expenses relating to the property or properties? Please state the amount of your mortgage payment, if any, and the amount of your taxes, insurance and utility payments, if any, and your method of payment of these expenses.

items.label: e
items.prompt: Do you own any rental properties, by yourself, with someone else or in trust? If the answer is yes:
items.text: Did you have to apply for a loan to finance any part of the real property or to finance the purchase of any personal property? If so, identify the item, state the amount of the loan and give a copy of the loan application.

items.label: a
items.prompt: Are you the beneficiary or settlor of a trust?
items.text: If so, please identify the trust, the type of trust, the date of the creation of the trust, the name and address of the trustee and how the trust is funded.

items.label: b
items.prompt: Are you the beneficiary or settlor of a trust?
items.text: How often do you receive a distribution from the trust and from whom and in what amounts are the distributions?
